stem: A flower sample appears to have many stalked glandular trichomes. Which conclusion stays within the evidence available from visual inspection?
choices: The tissue has visible glandular-trichome morphology that can be documented, but chemical concentration requires analytical measurement
The sample's exact THC percentage can be calculated visually
The sample necessarily contains more terpenes than every less-frosted sample
The trichome appearance proves the cultivar identity
rationale: Cannabis glandular trichomes are specialized metabolite-producing structures, but visible abundance or appearance is not a validated quantitative assay of cannabinoid or terpene concentration.
